name: near
description: NEAR Protocol as one mod. NEAR's personality is its account model: accounts are human-readable names (alice.near) or 64-hex implicit accounts, an account and a contract are the same object, and access keys carry per-contract permissions — session auth on chain. This module reads all of it (balances with staked and storage-locked NEAR priced in USD, access keys, contract methods parsed from the deployed WASM export section, view calls, NEP-141 tokens, history, transactions, validators) and now writes all of it: a keystore under ~/.mod/near/, contract deploys with a batched init call (redeploying upgrades in place), signed change calls with gas and deposit, transfers, account creation (testnet faucet mints funded *.testnet names; elsewhere sub-accounts of the signer), access-key management. Writes default to testnet; a non-testnet write refuses without confirm=true; a write over HTTP needs the token from ~/.mod/near/token. ed25519 via PyNaCl with a pure-Python RFC 8032 fallback, borsh in-tree — still zero hard dependencies. A curated directory of the contracts that are ON — well-known contracts per network plus anything deployed from the keystore — is re-verified live against the chain. And a census the chain itself cannot be asked for: a scraper tails every new block's state changes to catch each contract deploy as it lands, backfills history backwards through the archival RPC, and folds in every lookup that finds code — a local, self-sustaining index of every contract on the network, no third-party indexer, resuming across restarts. Semantic search over that census runs locally too: tf-idf over account ids, curated labels and parsed WASM method names, a concept lexicon so "stablecoin" finds USDt and "lending" finds Burrow, trigrams so typos still land — no model, no external service. And the thing NEAR never had: an interface for every contract, inferred. Contracts built with cargo-near carry a zstd-compressed near-abi behind a __contract_abi export — decoded exactly. Every other contract is probed: each method is called as a free view and the panic text read back — ProhibitedInView says change, "missing field x" names a required argument, "invalid type: null, expected a string" types it, "requires attached deposit of exactly 1 yoctoNEAR" is the transfer convention, "already initialized" is the constructor — iterated until the method stops asking; NEP-141/145/148/171/177/178/181/245/330 names fill in what the standards fix; the indexer's recent receipts supply real example args. One spec per contract, cached by code hash, and one generic HTML page at /near/c/<contract> that renders any of them as working forms: view methods call free, change methods sign through the keystore. MCP tools, a REST API and a browser console run the same code on one port. And a school with a builder: /near/workshop teaches smart contracts from zero (twelve lessons, from "an account is a contract" through tokens, cross-contract calls and a zero-knowledge ladder), scaffolds Rust crates from starters (counter, token, commit_reveal, merkle_allowlist), builds and tests them with the host cargo, ships them through the keystore, and runs two agents on the fleet's agent protocol: a free tutor that answers from the lessons, your projects and the chain, and a builder that hands a crate to orbit/claudecode and streams its steps. Zero knowledge climbs out of NEAR: commitments and merkle proofs are built here, and anything that says zk, cairo, anonymous or private is forwarded whole to the cairo mod's builder, whose lessons the tutor also reads over its MCP.

endpoints.app: GET /near/c/<contract> — generic contract page: the inferred interface as forms
endpoints.call_change: POST /call {contract, method, args?, gas_tgas?, deposit_near?, token}
endpoints.workshop: GET /near/workshop — LEARN + BUILD page: lessons, starters, projects, build/test/ship, tutor orb
endpoints.run: POST /near/run | /near/run/stream {query, agent?:tutor|builder, brain?, context?} — SSE steps then done
endpoints.new: POST /new {name, template?, desc?, token} — scaffold a Rust crate under contracts/<name>/
endpoints.build: POST /build|/verify|/check {name, wait?, token} — cargo build → .wasm / cargo test (jobs)
endpoints.vibe: POST /vibe {name, prompt, model?, token} — orbit/claudecode edits the crate, then build + test
endpoints.ship: POST /ship {name, account_id?, network?, init_method?, init_args?, confirm?, token} — deploy via the keystore
endpoints.zk: GET /zk?what=lessons|lesson|contracts|templates — the cairo mod's ZK school + contracts over its MCP

backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib); WASM export-section parser, borsh serializer and RFC 8032 ed25519 in-tree (PyNaCl used when present)
auth: reads open; writes sign with keys from ~/.mod/near/ (never the repo) — non-testnet writes refuse without confirm=true, HTTP writes need the token from ~/.mod/near/token, secret keys never leave the keystore

env.PORT: port for API, console and MCP (default 50910)
env.NEAR_RPC: your own RPC endpoint — skips the public failover pool
env.NEAR_OFFLINE: skip the tests that need the chain
env.NEAR_SCRAPE: 0 turns the contract scraper's threads off (the stored index still answers)
env.NEAR_TAIL_POLL: seconds between chain-head checks for the live tail (default 6)
env.NEAR_SCAN_RPS: archival requests per second the history backfill spends (default 1)
env.NEAR_SEARCH_TTL: seconds the search index is reused before rebuilding from the store (default 60)
env.NEAR_ABI_MAX_CALLS: view calls one inference may spend probing (default 400)
env.NEAR_ABI_ROUNDS: probe rounds per method before giving up on its args (default 6)
env.NEAR_AGENT_URL: orbit/claudecode base the builder/vibe hands crates to (default http://127.0.0.1:51260)
env.NEAR_CAIRO_URL: orbit/cairo base for the ZK rungs — lessons over its MCP, ZK builds forwarded to its builder (default http://127.0.0.1:51291)
env.NEAR_TUTOR_TIMEOUT: seconds a builder run may wait on claudecode (default 420)

agents.tutor: open, no model: teaches NEAR contracts and the ZK ladder, reads your projects and any contract on chain
agents.builder: token/loopback: "make a tip jar called tips" scaffolds + claudecode edits + cargo build/test; zk/cairo/anonymous/private asks are forwarded to orbit/cairo's builder and its steps stream back
